owner_instruction: Remove the former nine-player Blue Officer role from the game. Officer remains only the public office appointed by Captain.

decisions.rule: Officer is not a secret role, a Blue faction assignment or a ninth setup card. It is a public office held alongside the player's secret role and appointed by Captain.
The public Officer office grants no starting weapon, early shot or lifetime shooting exception. All weapon eligibility follows the holder's secret role and the ordinary rules.
Undercover alone starts with one ordinary weapon. Other roles require a Supplier grant to obtain an ordinary weapon. Ordinary shooting remains restricted to Rounds 4 and 5.
Do not offer the removed Blue Officer as an alternate, optional role or unresolved design choice. Historical source files and historical match versions remain evidence only.

setup_follow_up: Seven- and eight-player role compositions are unchanged. No replacement ninth secret role, duplicate role or new nine-player composition is approved by this decision.
implementation_boundary: Update the design reference and its current summaries. Existing immutable engine/ruleset tuples and match histories are not silently rewritten. A gameplay successor must implement the public office and reconcile supported setup counts.
